description: Positive QuantiFERON result was 7 years ago instead of 5 years ago
presentation: A 62-year-old woman with metastatic breast cancer on checkpoint immunotherapy developed presumed immunotherapy pneumonitis requiring multiple courses of prednisone (each more than 1 month long), most recently completed 2 months ago. A CT chest now shows diffuse bronchial wall thickening and tree-in-bud opacities. She remains dry-coughing and dyspneic off steroids. Patient has a history of positive quantiferon with negative AFB testing x 3 about 7 years prior. What dose of steroids should be restarted and what is an appropriate taper plan?
